narrative: OMX30 enters Thursday on moderately positive footing supported by US overnight strength and broad-based commodity appreciation. The index sits +6.5% above its 200-day MA in established bull regime, with 90-day ROC confirming +5.3% underlying momentum. However, technical structure shows caution: MACD trades below signal line (hist=-7.158), ADX at 12.4 signals weak trend conviction, and Bollinger positioning (lower half, %B=0.32) suggests potential consolidation near current levels around 3123. The +0.79% VIX uptick warrants monitoring. Key support at 3085 (lower band), resistance at 3180 (50-MA). Commodity tailwinds (particularly copper/gold) benefit mining and industrial exporters, but weak ADX requires 30% magnitude reduction in sector conviction.
morningBrief: OMX30 set for modest up-open tracking positive US close and strong commodity backdrop. Watch 3123 pivot—break above 3150 would challenge 3180 resistance; slip below 3110 risks 3085 support. Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo, Sandvik) and Mining (Boliden) in focus on copper/gold strength; Boliden flagged as core long given +1.72% copper and +2.46% gold. Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken) neutral—yields flat overnight at 4.796%. Tech/Telecom sector remains headwind-sensitive given NASDAQ momentum +0.45% but weak ADX = hold conviction. EUR/SEK down 0.13% is modest tailwind for H&M sourcing but not game-changing. ADX weakness means avoid aggressive bets; trade ranges with discipline. US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) only meaningful eco print today. Keep stops tight given Bollinger lower-half positioning.
